## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change that addresses it.

## Verification

- [ ] Formatting, linting, and strict type checking pass.
- [ ] Relevant unit or component tests pass.
- [ ] The production static export builds.
- [ ] Relevant Playwright and accessibility checks pass.
- [ ] Documentation and checklist items are updated when needed.

## Privacy and Kubernetes accuracy

- [ ] Fixtures and screenshots use synthetic data with no credentials or Secret values.
- [ ] The change preserves browser-only processing and adds no undeclared telemetry.
- [ ] Static-analysis claims do not imply observed live-cluster state.

## Visual evidence

Add synthetic screenshots only when they materially help review. Otherwise write `Not applicable`.
